rule: logic: missing reported for a lockfile with no packages
reasoning: npm never creates node_modules/.package-lock.json for a lockfile that lists no packages besides the root, so installNeed returns 'missing' on every run and slot-serve reinstalls and restarts the servers each time.
When the hash file is missing installNeed returns 'changed', and nothing ever writes the hash file, so every run reinstalls.

rule: runtime: lockHash on a missing lockfile
reasoning: lockHash(lockPath) reads package-lock.json without checking it exists, so a folder without a lockfile throws ENOENT.
